name: tandem
description: Bidirectional bridge between Claude Code and Codex (ChatGPT): code review, adversarial review, task delegation, background jobs, models consulting each other, and image generation via Codex's built-in tool. Runs on your existing ChatGPT subscription, no API keys.

review_backend.title: Code review backend
review_backend.description: exec (default) uses the established codex exec review path. app-server explicitly enables Codex's native review/start reviewer; it falls back to exec only if review/start was not accepted.

language.title: Language of descriptions, messages and prompts
language.description: en — English (default), ru — Russian. Prompts are sent to the invoked model in the selected language, so its answers follow it as well. Commands and agents are always in English.

default_model.title: Default Codex model
default_model.description: For example gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.4-mini, gpt-5.3-codex-spark. Empty means Codex's own default.

default_effort.title: Default reasoning effort
default_effort.description: Reasoning level. The available set depends on the model — /tandem:models shows the exact list. Only earlier-generation models accept minimal; gpt-5.6 and newer reject it.

reasoning_summary.title: Reasoning summaries
reasoning_summary.description: auto — Codex decides (there may be no summaries at all), detailed — verbose summaries in the progress trail. The model's full reasoning is unavailable at any value.

progress_notifications.title: Show progress during a call
progress_notifications.description: Codex's action trail is sent to the client as notifications/progress. Turn this off if your Claude Code build is affected by anthropics/claude-code#47378: there, receiving such notifications closes the MCP server connection and the next call fails with "Connection closed".

max_parallel_jobs.title: Limit of concurrent Codex jobs
max_parallel_jobs.description: How many jobs may run at once. Each one is a separate Codex process consuming ChatGPT quota and memory. Zero removes the limit.

job_timeout_minutes.title: Background job timeout (min)
job_timeout_minutes.description: After this time the job is marked as timeout and the process is killed.

image_output_dir.title: Directory for images
image_output_dir.description: Where to put generated files, relative to the project root.

image_timeout_minutes.title: Image generation timeout (min)
image_timeout_minutes.description: Codex's built-in tool usually answers within 4–6 minutes, longer at 4K.

bypass_sandbox.title: Bypass the Codex sandbox (emergency mode)
bypass_sandbox.description: Enable only if the Codex sandbox is broken by a version mismatch and /tandem:setup confirms it. Codex will then run commands without isolation. The proper fix is to reinstall Codex.
